newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to introduce currency board in June.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to introduce currency board in June.

text.p: Bulgaria will introduce a currency board system in June, an International Monetary Fund (IMF) official said on Monday.
IMF mission leader Anne McGuirk told a news conference the lev would be pegged around the market exchange rate at the time.

IMF officials at the news conference said it had not yet been decided whether to peg the lev to the dollar or the mark under the system, which matches central bank reserves to currency in circulation.
McGuirk said the new parliament which will take office after April 19 general elections would have to pass the necessary legal amendments for a currency board, and also a state budget.
She said measures would be taken at the same time to stabilise Bulgaria's banking system before the mechanism was introduced.

"We agreed on immediate steps to strengthen any weaknesses in the state banks and we have agreed financing resources of about $50 million dollars that would be available in the period immediately ahead," McGuirk said.
